title: Compact 3-line session rows: title+age, context excerpt, project+badges
source: exploration plan §1-3: three-line rows without blank spacer, title+right-aligned age, contextual excerpt, project identity and status badges
why_chosen: Highest user-visible density improvement. Replaces 5-6 line cards with 3-line compact rows, approximately doubling visible session count.
before: Sessions showed 5-6 lines: title (with all badges on line1), message counts + tokens, 'prompt: ...' excerpt, 'created: N ago' + path, optional crash reason, blank spacer. Titles clipped at 54 chars but crammed with all status badges on the same line.
after: Three-line format: Line 1: selection marker + icon + title + activity age. Line 2: first-user-prompt excerpt (100-cell max, no 'prompt:' prefix). Line 3: project dirname · source badge · 📌 saved · ▸ here · ◀ current · status icon + label. Message counts, tokens, full path, created time moved off-row (available in details/preview). Changed DEFAULT_ITEM_HEIGHT_ESTIMATE from 5 to 3.
evidence: All 95 existing session_picker tests pass. Compilation succeeds. No new warnings.
open_questions: Should we add a 'latest user request' excerpt from the full transcript instead of only first_user_prompt? (requires loader/cache changes)
Should canary/debug markers be shown in the compact rows? (currently absent)
